title: [review] handoff.rs:738: Status code truncation al
description: The status code is read as i128 via get_int() then cast to u8 with `as u8`. Values like 256, 512, etc. truncate to 0, which maps to Success via try_from(). A malicious or buggy peer could send status=256 and have it accepted as a successful handoff response, bypassing rejection.
